primaryAuthority: IRS Notice on 2026 retirement plan limitations; Rev. Proc. 2025-32
secondarySource: Edward Jones 2026 Retirement Planning & Support card and 2026 IRAs card (advisor-supplied, 2026-08-19)
sourceNote: Transcribed from an advisor reference card. Numeric tax limits are facts, but per rule R3 each must be traced to the IRS notice before shipping.

electiveDeferral.rothCatchUpMandate: For 2026, catch-up contributions to qualified plans by employees with prior-year compensation over $150,000 must be designated Roth.

rothIraContributionMagiPhaseout.note: Phaseout of the ability to make a REGULAR Roth contribution. There is NO income limit on a Roth CONVERSION. Do not conflate them.

traditionalIraDeductibilityMagi.relevanceToConversions: Non-deductible contributions create IRA basis on Form 8606, which makes part of every later conversion tax-free under the pro-rata rule. Master Spec section 6.

saversCredit.conversionInteraction: A Roth conversion raises MAGI and can phase out or destroy the saver's credit for a lower-income client. This is a real marginal cost the tool must model for households near these thresholds.
